charts.title: K2-222 b: orbits around K2-222
charts.description: The orbits of K2-222's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-222 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Palethorpe et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag520P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PALETHORPE_ET_AL_2026): P 15.3889274 d

charts.title: K2-222 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-222 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (42, 43, 70) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 257774438, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 18-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
